# Tango Garden Cologne

> Argentine tango school in Cologne, Germany. Beginner-friendly classes taught in English — no partner or prior experience needed.

Tango Garden Cologne teaches Argentine tango to adults in Cologne (Köln), Germany. The
school is built around complete beginners: no partner, no dance experience, and no
particular gender/role assumption is required to start. Classes are taught in English.

## Classes

- [The Sprouting Sessions — 12-week beginner course](https://tangogarden.de/pages/beginner-course): weekly beginner Argentine tango course at Thürmchenswall 21, Köln. No partner or experience needed; free makeup classes via the practica.
- [Enter the Garden — free intro session](https://tangogarden.de/pages/enter-the-garden): free, one-hour, open-air introduction to tango at Rheinpark, Köln.
- [The Garden Practica — open practice](https://tangogarden.de/pages/garden-practica): weekly guided drop-in practica for dancers with some tango experience.
- [Classes & Passes overview](https://tangogarden.de/collections/all): all classes and current prices in one place.

## About

- [The Garden — our story](https://tangogarden.de/pages/the-garden): philosophy, teachers, and who Tango Garden is for.
- [Contact](https://tangogarden.de/pages/contact): location, phone, email, WhatsApp.
